en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1359 - Al-‘Abbas ibn Hilal reported from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (as), from his father (as) who said:
"No one has ever recited, when intending to sleep :
'Indeed, Allah (swt) holds the heavens and the earth lest they cease, and if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing and Forgiving' (Qur'an 35:41)
without being protected, such that even if a house were to collapse upon him, he would be safe."
